cli.help.modelsConnect:
Usage: deckent models connect --scope <id> --connection <kind> --command-id <id>
         (--model <exact_api_id> | --reference <provider@v/model@v>)
         [--endpoint <url>] [--json] [--lang <locale>]
Connects one model: declares it from the kind's packaged catalog (or uses a
model already declared), writes the scope's invocation profile with the
connection's key NAME, and activates it. Each write is governed: policy,
approval where policy asks, audit. Kinds: anthropic-api, openai-api,
deepseek-api, zai-api, zai-cn-api, openai-compatible, local-openai.
--endpoint only for openai-compatible and local-openai. The same command id
continues after an approval; nothing already in place is written again.
models.connect.notCarried: Lost its activation with the catalog change (activate it again with deckent models activate): {models}
error.BACKUP_PASSPHRASE_INVALID: The passphrase is invalid or does not open this recovery set.
error.BACKUP_PATH_UNSAFE: The recovery path has unsafe ownership, permissions, links or an incompatible layout.
error.BACKUP_DIRECTORY_UNSAFE: The directory {path} is not yours or other users can write to it; nothing was changed. Run chmod 700 {path} as its owner, then rerun the same command.
error.BACKUP_POLICY_UNREADABLE: The installation policy file {path} cannot be used ({reason}); nothing was changed. A damaged policy is never replaced silently: to recover it from the set, move it aside (mv {path} {path}.damaged) and rerun the same deckent backup restore, which then uses the set's authenticated policy. Create and verify need the file repaired first.
error.BACKUP_LIMIT: The recovery set exceeds the configured size or entry bound.
error.BACKUP_KEY_INVALID: The installation authority key is missing or invalid.
error.BACKUP_SET_INVALID: The recovery set format is invalid.
error.BACKUP_MANIFEST_INVALID: The recovery manifest does not match the set.
error.BACKUP_FINGERPRINT_INVALID: The ledger fingerprint does not match the set.
error.BACKUP_LEDGER_INVALID: The recovery ledger fails its integrity check.
error.BACKUP_STATE_MISSING: Required installation recovery state is missing.
error.BACKUP_TIMEOUT: The online ledger backup exceeded its deadline.
error.BACKUP_TARGET_NOT_EMPTY: The restore target is not empty; confirm the exact target.
error.BACKUP_SERVICE_RUNNING: Stop the service before restoring; its socket or ledger custody is present.
error.BACKUP_CUSTODY_UNAVAILABLE: Exclusive restore custody could not be established.
error.BACKUP_IO: The backup operation failed; inspect its retained audit intent before retrying.
error.BACKUP_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE: Backup audit could not be persisted; inspect retained intent and actual state before retrying.
error.BACKUP_SCHEDULE_IDENTITY_REQUIRED: Select a service identity before enabling scheduled backups.
error.BACKUP_SCHEDULE_SECRET_REQUIRED: Provision BACKUP_PASSPHRASE in the selected secret store.
cli.help.summary.backup: Create, verify and restore recovery sets
cli.backup.relocated: Identity relocated. In {target}, run deckent init identity --keep.
cli.backup.globalKept: The global configuration {path} keeps its own value for: {sections}.
cli.help.backup:
Usage: deckent backup <create|verify|restore> --scope <id> --set <path>
  restore: --target <project> [--confirm-target <absolute-project>]
  [--json] [--lang en|tr]
Passphrase: hidden prompt or stdin; never an argument.
Stop the target service first. Existing files are preserved beside replacements.
A relocated identity needs deckent init identity --keep.
error.BACKUP_STATE_CHANGED: Recovery state changed while it was read; retry after writers settle.
error.BACKUP_TARGET_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: The set belongs to a different installation; restore to a separate empty target.
error.BACKUP_RESTORE_INCOMPLETE: Restore publication is incomplete; the installation stays held. Keep damaged copies and staging, inspect the audit intent, then rerun the same restore with --confirm-target.
error.BACKUP_RESTORE_HOLD: An unfinished backup restore holds this installation ({path}); nothing configured runs. Rerun deckent backup restore with the same set and --confirm-target to finish it; remove the hold only after inspecting the damaged copies and the restore audit.
